## 1. Flagship Specialist: Microwave Oven Repair in Bengaluru

- **URL**: https://urbanservicecompany.in/services/microwave-repair
- **Doorstep Response Time**: 45 to 60 minutes across Bengaluru
- **Diagnosis**: Free. A quote is shared before any work and you approve it first.
- **Warranty**: Quality assured repair with 90-day warranty on replacement spare parts
- **Technologies Supported**:
  - **Solo Microwaves**: Basic reheating and defrosting (e.g., magnetron, high-voltage diode, capacitor, door safety interlock switch).
  - **Grill Microwaves**: Dual heating with quartz/sheath grill elements, thermistor sensors, relay boards.
  - **Convection Microwaves**: Baking, browning, convection fan motor, heating coil, temperature sensors, main inverter PCB.
- **Brands Supported**: LG (Smart Inverter, Charcoal Lighting), Samsung (Ceramic Enamel, Slim Fry), IFB, Whirlpool, Panasonic (Inverter), Godrej, Bajaj, Morphy Richards, Haier, Bosch.

### Common Microwave Symptoms & Diagnoses
- **Microwave Not Heating**: 85% caused by blown high-voltage diode (10kV rating), shorted capacitor, or worn-out magnetron cathode.
- **Sparking Inside Cavity**: 90% caused by burnt/carbonized mica waveguide cover on right inner wall, or peeled cavity paint.
- **Turntable Not Rotating**: Broken plastic coupler or burnt 21V/220V synchronous turntable motor.
- **Touchpad Not Working**: Heat/steam delamination of internal ribbon cable circuits; fixed via membrane replacement.
